main.description: Pending handoffs by id: removed active segments and dive sites no live one has taken over, for the segment importer to republish. A pending handoff a live segment or site now duplicates is linked to it and left out. Never says who rode or dived one, or who created it. Only the AppView's configured segment importer may call it, with service auth.

errors.name: NotImporter
errors.description: The caller isn't the configured segment importer, or none is configured.
